summary:
Results inbox worked under RBC-INBOX-01, RBC-LAB-03 and RBC-RAD-05. 12 of 13 items are closed. One stays open on purpose.

Original 8 items:
- pt-0006 Raj Patel, CT A/P 10-19 (incidental 4 mm LLL nodule): this nodule is already followed in lung screening. Ordered the screening LDCT for 2027-03-14 to 2027-05-14 (sr-t0001), added a tracking task (task-t0002), messaged the patient, wrote a note. All of this was replaced later (see arrivals below).
- pt-0016 TSH 2.1: normal. Closed.
- pt-0016 potassium: corrected from 6.3 to 4.4, normal. Acted on the corrected value and closed with no action.
- pt-0007 CTA chest preliminary report (5 mm RUL nodule): the final report (dr-00084) says it is a vessel, with no nodule and no follow-up needed. Closed with that comment.
- pt-0064 creatinine 1.36 (9/26): no earlier creatinine in the 48-hour or 7-day window, so not AKI. Closed.
- pt-0007 BMP 10-22, creatinine 1.64 vs 0.98 about 35 hours earlier: this is AKI. Ordered an urgent BMP by 10-26 (sr-t0009), sent an urgent patient message, wrote a note.
- pt-0033 creatinine 1.31: left out the 0.84 that was entered in error. Against the 1.27 from 10-17 it is not AKI. Closed.
- pt-0008 potassium 6.4 flagged hemolyzed: followed §2. Ordered an urgent BMP (sr-t0015) and messaged the patient. Did not notify on-call. Wrote a note.

Items that arrived while I worked (§8):
- pt-0008: the lab corrected the result. The specimen was not hemolyzed, so K 6.4 is real and §1 applies.
  - Ordered a stat BMP for today (sr-t0019) and sent pool-oncall a stat message.
  - Medication review: none of the usual potassium-raising drugs are on the list. Metoprolol was not held because stopping it suddenly is unsafe with ischemic heart disease.
  - Sent the patient a corrected message and wrote an addendum note.
- pt-0033: new creatinine 1.78 vs 1.31 about 9 hours earlier, which is AKI. Ordered an urgent BMP by 10-26 (sr-t0024), notified the patient, wrote a note. The earlier no-AKI call on the 1.31 was right for that result and stands.
- pt-0064: new creatinine 1.48 with no earlier value in the window, so not AKI. Closed.
- pt-0006: the screening program added an addendum to the 4/14 LDCT: a new 5 mm RUL nodule, Lung-RADS 3, repeat LDCT in 6 months.
  - Changed the plan to a new LDCT order for 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-14 (sr-t0029), timed from the April scan, with a tracking task due 11-14 (task-t0030).
  - Sent the patient a corrected message and wrote an addendum note.

Still open:
- pt-0007 chest X-ray 10-22 (inbox-a0002): the report is preliminary ("possible 7 mm RUL opacity") and no final version is in the record yet, so the policy says to leave it open. Act on it when the final report arrives.

For you to do (I had no way to cancel orders or my own tasks):
- pt-0006: please cancel the old 2027 LDCT order (sr-t0001) and close its tracking task (task-t0002). I left you a reminder task due 10-26 (task-t0031).
- pt-0008: please cancel the urgent BMP (sr-t0015). It duplicates today's stat order.

Not touched: your messages queue has 6 refill requests from 10-19 to 10-22 (pt-0030, pt-0027, pt-0031). That queue was outside this request.
